text: iPhone 14 Pro features the A16 Bionic chip. The A16 Bionic is manufactured by Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) on a 4-nanometer process. iPhone 14 Pro utilizes an OLED Super Retina XDR display supplied by Samsung Display.
iPhone 15 Pro features the A17 Pro chip and incorporates a grade 5 titanium frame. The iPhone 15 Pro replaces the lightning port with a USB-C controller manufactured by Texas Instruments.
